attack: The opposing USD-down / CAD-up package is a low-carry narrative: short USDCAD or long CAD pays about 156bp overnight (SOFR 3.85 versus CORRA 2.29) and still about 162bp in December (4.1975 versus 2.58). That coupon is verified. The catalyst offered against it is BoC energy-pass-through minutes plus 3% headline, against core near 2%, labor 38, and a Saudi STS workaround that reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. Minutes without a strip move are not a catalyst that has overwhelmed carry.

Paying Canada (COAZ26, short CA_2Y, or CAD-up FX) without receiving the US 2Y 4.76 discards the 140bp CA-US_2Y coupon. That is the trade I will not own. Value-guy’s CAD-up coloring of the same RV converts a carry harvest into a percentile-convergence mandate the mixed analogs (2025-01-30 +25bp 3m versus 2024-12-18 -20bp 3m) do not support.

Short AUDCAD is the cleanest confession: AONIA 4.35 versus CORRA 2.29 is about 206bp against the short, CA-AU_2Y is only 51st percentile 1y, and CFTC nets are null. Cross-merchant is asking to pay two-handle carry to fade a 5y FX extreme.

Paying US 2Y / Dec SOFR fights the high-carry leg of my RV. US 2Y already prints above the packet 2028 SOFR terminal. A 99.8th percentile yield is what a carry seat receives, not what it pays, unless the live SOFR path actually outruns 4.76.
defense: FACT: long CA-US_2Y is receive US 2Y 4.76 / pay CA 2Y 3.27 at a -140bp spread as of 2026-09-17. Holding-period return is the 140bp coupon plus any path persistence; Dec implied SOFR-CORRA still about 162bp so the market is not pricing the carry away. INFERENCE: this is not a CAD-up convergence trade and not a short-USDCAD trade. USD remains the high-carry currency; CAD remains the low-yielder whose +29bp Dec path is insurance, not a labor/core cycle. The 3.8th percentile is supporting context, not the thesis.

Spot long USDCAD was constructed and rejected: 74th percentile 1y after a +1.74% 1m rebound, weak r-squared 0.022 versus the 2Y gap, no executable mark. Rates is the default and is cleaner. AU receive was inspected (AONIA 4.35, +51bp to Mar-2027, housing downturn) and rejected versus US-over-CA.

I concede the CAD-up argument only if CORRA reprices more tightening than SOFR so the sourced Dec gap (4.1975 versus 2.58) and the sourced 140bp CA-US_2Y differential compress from the Canada side because energy pass-through overwhelms core-near-2% and labor 38. That path has not moved. A further analog-style cheapening without path compression is timing noise because carry is the engine. CFTC nets remain null; no executable marks; NZ rates unavailable and unused.
holes_in_opposing_case: FACT: overnight SOFR 3.85 versus CORRA 2.29 is 156bp; Dec implied 4.1975 versus 2.58 is still about 162bp; CA-US_2Y is -140bp as of 2026-09-17 with US 2Y 4.76 versus CA 2Y 3.27. INFERENCE: any USD-down / CAD-up expression (short USDCAD, long CAD, or a BoC-catch-up story that needs CAD to rally) pays that differential. That is the negative-carry bar the energy-minutes narrative does not clear. UNKNOWN: whether a future Canadian energy CPI print actually lifts CORRA more than SOFR.

catalyst-junkie (CAD_UP, USD_DOWN, pay COAZ26): FACT: they tag carry_view opposes_trade; Oct CORRA is still only +1.5bp and Dec only +29bp after the already-released 14-18 Sep cluster (BoC minutes, CPI 3%/core near 2%, Fed hike, BoJ 1.25%). INFERENCE: a dated catalyst that left the strip unmoved is the market treating minutes as a risk flag, not a lagging mispricing. Their own invalidation is live in the packet: core-near-2%, labor 38, and the Saudi STS workaround that reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. Closest same-regime CA 2Y analog 2026-04-01 then went +12bp 1m / -6bp 3m. UNKNOWN: MX CORRA OI/volume are null, so they cannot show the strip is unowned rather than fairly priced.

perma-bull (CAD_UP, USD_DOWN, short CA_2Y): FACT: carry_view opposes_trade; paying CA 2Y 3.27 is paying the low-yielder without receiving US 2Y 4.76; USDCAD versus CA-US_2Y r-squared is 0.022 and USDCAD versus WTI r-squared is 0.017 (both weak). INFERENCE: CAD-up is an FX inference the packet associations do not support, and outright short CA_2Y burns the 140bp US-over-CA coupon the RV would have harvested.
